dedupe_keys.name: mp evdata chinese multi prototype charging load profiles

description: The MP-EVData team publishes 2024 charging observations from ten stations in one Chinese metropolis. The stations represent taxi charging, bus depots, residential chargers, battery swapping and heavy-truck charging. The Figshare release includes session-level records, electricity prices, and station-level load profiles at fifteen-minute and hourly resolution, plus Python processing scripts. Own metadata declares CC BY 4.0 and free public access. These series can set load-shape and coincident-demand inputs for distribution-grid or transport electrification simulations with a model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that the city's name and station coordinates are not stated in the inspected summary, so regional transfer is uncertain. The article calls parts of the resource AI augmented, and synthetic or processed profiles must be distinguished from observed sessions. The own manifest and descriptor were read without downloading workbooks or checking missing intervals. This is a reopening of a rejected Figshare candidate, not a duplicate of a catalogue record.
